caption_L1: Here a is a line chart titled Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of the federal state of Hawaii from 2000 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars). The x-axis shows Year while the y-axis shows Real GDP in billion U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: There is a positive trend, over all as the years have gone by there has been an increase in GDP. It appears that GDP decreased around 2007-2008 then increased again. Over all increase of approx 22-23 billion US dollars.
